nodes.label: Unseen Pairs Upper Bound
nodes.rationale: With U unseen fields and S known singles the bound is floor(max(0, U - S) / 2), shown as up to N because hidden fields may also be bonuses. No fixed bonus count is assumed and no hidden position is ranked, since under uniform placement all never-revealed positions are equally likely.

nodes.label: Glass-Before-Reward Classification
nodes.rationale: The helper checked its broad bonus-name predicate before checking glass, so every concealed slot carrying a button prompt could enter the remembered bonus set and permanently reduce the pair total. Classification now checks glass first and excludes decorations, controls and player inventory.

nodes.label: Gained Clicks Bonus Classification
nodes.rationale: A feather named Gained +3 Clicks was classified as a reward single, inventing a missing partner and producing a false zero bound. Gained Click items now count as bonuses while glass prompts and unrelated feathers keep their classifications.

nodes.label: Enchanted Book Lore Parsing
nodes.rationale: Books named Enchanted Book read the enchantment and level from lore even when Hypixel uses a sword, bow or armor icon, and without a recognizable lore line the original name is kept. Equal XP amounts on distinct icons stay distinct identities because combining them would corrupt counting.
